description: Dashboard Recent Digest zone view (issue #170) — read-only top-N recent completed/failed/archived issues summary mounted into the Dashboard digest slot.

tasks.title: Dashboard Digest zone content: recent-digest derivation + widget
tasks.description: Build the recent-history derivation as a pure function plus hook in entities/issue/lib/recent-digest.ts (reuse the completion-snapshot taxonomy: completed = status 'done', failed = status 'cancelled', ordered by updatedAt desc; archived ordered by archivedAt desc; each sliced to a fixed top-N), and the widgets/dashboard-digest view (DigestRow + DashboardDigestWidget) that renders completed/failed/archived sections as jumpable rows with number, title, relative timestamp, plus distinct loading and empty states.
acceptanceCriteria: deriveRecentDigest categorizes active issues into completed (status 'done') and failed (status 'cancelled') ordered by updatedAt desc, and archived issues ordered by archivedAt desc, each sliced to DIGEST_TOP_N (5), most-recent first
deriveRecentDigest is a pure function (no React imports) and useRecentDigest wraps useIssues + useArchivedIssues, returning { completed, failed, archived, isLoading }

Unit tests in recent-digest.test.ts cover: categorization correctness, ordering (most-recent first), top-N cap when a category exceeds N, empty input returns empty arrays, and taxonomy alignment with completion-snapshot
DashboardDigestWidget renders a section per non-empty category; each DigestRow shows issue number, title, and relative timestamp via shared formatTimeAgo
Each DigestRow navigates to /issues/<number> using useProjectPath (same target as RecentCard/IssueCard)
Widget renders a loading indicator while queries are isLoading, and an empty-state message only once data resolves with all three categories empty (distinct from loading)
Component tests cover populated (mixed categories), all-empty (empty state), and loading renders
npm run typecheck -w packages/web passes with no errors
tasks.notes: Activity event summary is DEFERRED (design D5); do not implement it in this task. Do NOT reuse the RecentCard component (its SessionCardType props do not match Issue) — build a slim DigestRow; only reuse its patterns (useProjectPath + formatTimeAgo). Use the shared formatTimeAgo in shared/lib/format-time.ts (convert ISO via new Date(iso)). Export DIGEST_TOP_N = 5 as a constant. Call useIssues/useArchivedIssues with explicit { projectId } from useProject, matching IssuesPage.tsx.

tasks.title: Mount Digest widget into the Dashboard digest slot
tasks.description: Wire DashboardPage to render the dashboard-digest widget when zone.id === 'digest' instead of DashboardZonePlaceholder, while attention/pulse/productivity remain empty placeholders. Preserve the slot-identity contract (data-testid='dashboard-zone-digest' and data-zone='digest') on the rendered wrapper.
acceptanceCriteria: DashboardPage renders the DashboardDigestWidget for the digest zone id
attention, pulse, and productivity zones still render DashboardZonePlaceholder (unchanged)
The digest zone wrapper preserves data-testid='dashboard-zone-digest' and data-zone='digest' so existing dashboard-shell identity scenarios still pass
DashboardPage.test.tsx updated to assert: digest slot renders digest content (not the placeholder), the other three slots still render placeholders, and the project empty-state path is unaffected
npm run typecheck -w packages/web and npm run test:run -w packages/web pass with no errors
tasks.notes: Use a simple conditional render (design D2); a zone-id->component registry is deferred as YAGNI until the second zone lands. Do not touch the project empty-state branch (no projects -> No projects yet).
